capture_plan.method: Two deterministic live runs use one executable, the same settled bake, simulation steps, camera, pixel policy, and disabled AA. Only --no-destruction-relighting differs. Rebuild requests frame-0 pixels before its single primary render and restores the saved view and neon stage after frame 959 without another simulation step.

asset.override: VERSE_KIT_PACK selects the current production pin; no unpinned admission.
asset.scope: Production kit textures and meshes with the showcase settled bake. The full-town B2 multilayer sidecar is not an input to this showcase capture.

pixel_readback.timing_scope: Every simulation frame calls the primary renderer once, advances history and exposure, and enters phase statistics without outlier filtering. Any initial exposure warm-up submissions drain before primary frame 0; their count and timing policy appear in submission_timing. Encode timing includes validation, fitting, uploads, encoding, submission, and optional diagnostics. The wait column includes oldest-submission admission in bounded mode, current completion in serial mode, and selected pixel copy/mapping/extraction. Unselected frames omit pixel operations. Pipelined PNG writes and progress logs occur after final drain; serial captures retain their historical writes. Repeated comparisons and extra readbacks are excluded from the historical component sum but retained in continuous iteration timing. Temporal comparisons remain serial and preserve all-frame pixel readback and warmed paired intervals.

submission_timing.warmup_method: This stage required no separate exposure warm-up submissions.
submission_timing.frame_ms_method: Historical serial tick plus dynamic mesh plus encode/submit plus current completion sum. Continuous iteration intervals additionally retain camera, telemetry, PNG/video/log work and diagnostic comparison renders; those appear separately. No frame is filtered.
submission_timing.completion_method: One callback per primary submission records the host observation after GPU completion. Callbacks can be delayed until submit/poll; observed latency is an upper bound, not GPU duration. Submitted and completed frame indices must match exactly. All frames submit once; no presentation, vsync, compositor, or dropped-frame behavior is simulated. Native surface latency 2 is a backend hint; this offscreen run explicitly caps pending primary submissions at 2.

acceptance.scope: Serial control timings retained; these do not establish the #10937 bounded throughput budget.

rebuild_capture.method: Applies the same rebuild intent as R after the final simulation frame, then renders with the saved pristine camera and stage without advancing simulation. The runtime clock and character state continue; exact pristine bake restoration is checked by unit tests.

supplementary_b3.scope: Separate B3 branch validates mutable light uploads; these tests are not attributed to the series source.

validation.gpu_timing: Timestamp diagnostics are disabled; no GPU-duration claim.
validation.timing: All 960 serial samples remain, including startup. The enabled serial swarm p99 is 19.145168 ms; this visual control does not assert the #10937 bounded throughput budget.

acceptance.visual_artifacts: No new lighting seams, detached light patches, or fire regression observed in the retained views.
acceptance.review: Matched debris silhouettes and effects remain. Enabled fallback slightly changes exposed interior, rubble, and receiver light; the standing neighbor remains plausible. R restores roof, wall, window, and ground lighting with the saved view.
acceptance.basis: Visual inspection plus passing damage/support-neighbor/ground/late-bake/LOD/R unit regressions in current-checks-build.log.
acceptance.limitations: Fire and smoke obscure interior contact regions, so the wide views cannot isolate every stale shadow. Exact pristine/R image equality is not asserted: 7,157 of 2,073,600 pixels differ while clock and character state continue. Exact baked ambient/lamp restoration is checked by unit tests. No GPU or serial throughput acceptance claim.

coordination.scope: Showcase destruction fallback only. This change does not implement or close the broader town B3 work.

pixel_comparisons.method: Exact RGB8 comparisons of saved pixels. Differences locate changed output; they do not independently prove geometry identity or lighting quality.
